items.question: Is this legal advice?
items.answer: No. Umbrella provides legal information and guidance to help you understand your situation. For formal legal advice, connect with a licensed lawyer through our platform.

items.question: How much does the free preview cost?
items.answer: The legal issue checker preview is free for registered users, with a limited number of AI credits included. Full reports and lawyer review are paid upgrades.

items.question: Which jurisdictions are fully supported?
items.answer: We have full legal database coverage with jurisdiction-specific laws and a local lawyer marketplace. We accept issues from all locations and provide best-effort guidance where full coverage isn't yet available.

items.question: Can lawyers use this platform too?
items.answer: Yes. Umbrella is built for both sides. Individuals get guided legal analysis and document support. Law firms get a full practice management workspace — matter tracking, billing, meeting transcripts, an AI Copilot, and a client intake pipeline — all in one place.

items.question: What happens to my data?
items.answer: Your data is private to your account. Other users and firms cannot access it. We never use your data to train AI models without explicit consent, and your data stays in your region.

items.question: How is Umbrella different from other legal tools?
items.answer: Most legal software was built for one audience — either large firm billing or generic document storage. Umbrella is built from the ground up to understand legal context: it reads your situation, maps it to applicable law, and helps you act. It works for individuals and firms, with everything connected in one platform.

legal.privacyDescription: How Umbrella collects, uses, and protects your information. This policy applies to all users of umbrella.okaylegal.ai and related Umbrella applications across India, the United States, Kenya, and the United Kingdom.
legal.privacyControllerBody: Umbrella is operated by DVTech Ventures ("we", "us", "our"). We act as the data controller for information collected from consumers and as a data processor for information held on behalf of law firm tenants. Registered address and data-protection contact: support@odaflow.com. For GDPR purposes, our EU/UK representative can be contacted at the same address.
legal.privacyLegalBasisBody: We process personal data under the following legal bases depending on your jurisdiction: (a) Contract — processing necessary to deliver services you have signed up for; (b) Legitimate interests — fraud prevention, platform security, product improvement; (c) Consent — AI training, marketing emails, cookies beyond strictly necessary; (d) Legal obligation — compliance with applicable law. For India, processing is governed by the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDP Act). For the UK/EU, processing complies with the UK GDPR and EU GDPR. For Kenya, processing complies with the Data Protection Act 2019. For US users, we comply with applicable state privacy laws including the CCPA/CPRA.
legal.privacyCollectAccountBody: Account data: email address, full name, phone number (optional), country of residence, and password hash. For lawyer users: bar registration number, firm name, practice areas, and jurisdiction.
legal.privacyCollectUsageBody: Usage data: pages visited, features used, AI queries submitted, documents uploaded, time spent, click events, and session recordings (where consent is given). This data is collected via first-party analytics.
legal.privacyCollectDeviceBody: Device and technical data: IP address, browser type, operating system, device identifiers, screen resolution, and timezone. Used for security, fraud prevention, and service compatibility.
legal.privacyCollectContentBody: Content data: legal documents, case descriptions, matter notes, client communications, and AI-generated outputs that you create or submit through the platform. This content is processed to deliver the service and is not used for AI training without your explicit opt-in.
legal.privacyCollectBillingBody: Billing data: subscription plan, payment method type (card brand, last four digits), billing address, and transaction history. Full payment card details are handled by our PCI-DSS-compliant payment processor (Stripe) and are never stored on our servers.
legal.privacyCollectCookiesBody: Cookies and tracking: we use strictly-necessary session cookies, functional preference cookies, and — with your consent — analytics cookies (Vercel Analytics, Sentry error tracking). You may manage cookie preferences via the cookie settings panel.
legal.privacyUseBody: We use collected data to: (a) create and maintain your account; (b) deliver AI legal analysis, matter management, billing, research, and other platform features; (c) process payments and send invoices; (d) send transactional emails (account confirmation, password reset, billing receipts); (e) detect, investigate, and prevent fraud, security incidents, and abuse; (f) comply with legal obligations including court orders and regulatory requirements; (g) analyse aggregate platform usage to improve features (using anonymized or pseudonymized data only); (h) send marketing communications where you have opted in (you may withdraw consent at any time).
legal.privacySharingHeading: 5. Who we share your data with
legal.privacySharingBody: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only as follows:
legal.privacySharingSubprocessors: Subprocessors: we engage third-party subprocessors under data-processing agreements that require equivalent protections. Key categories: (i) Cloud infrastructure — AWS (data hosted in the region closest to your country); (ii) Payment processing — Stripe; (iii) Error monitoring — Sentry; (iv) Analytics — Vercel; (v) AI model providers — OpenAI and DeepSeek (AI analysis and embeddings); Deepgram (meeting transcription) — queries are sent under zero-data-retention API agreements where available; (vi) Email delivery — Resend.
legal.privacySharingLawyerReview: Lawyer review: if you request a lawyer review, your case summary (not full content unless you authorise it) is shared with the assigned licensed lawyer on our marketplace. You control what is shared.
legal.privacySharingLegal: Legal disclosures: we may disclose data when required by law, court order, or regulatory authority, and will notify you unless legally prohibited from doing so.
legal.privacyRetentionBody: We retain personal data for as long as your account is active. On account deletion, we delete or anonymize personal data within 30 days, except where retention is required by law (e.g., billing records retained for 7 years for tax compliance, audit logs retained for 12 months). Firm tenants may configure custom retention policies up to 7 years via governance settings. AI-training datasets derived from opted-in content are subject to the retention schedule in our Data & AI Consent Policy.
legal.privacySecurityBody: We implement technical and organisational measures including: TLS 1.2+ encryption in transit; AES-256 encryption at rest; role-based access control with least-privilege principles; multi-factor authentication for administrative access; automated vulnerability scanning; penetration testing at least annually; and an incident response plan. In the event of a personal data breach affecting your rights, we will notify you within 72 hours of becoming aware, as required under applicable law.
legal.privacyChildrenBody: Umbrella is not directed at persons under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has submitted data to us, contact support@odaflow.com and we will delete it promptly.
legal.privacyRightsGDPRBody: GDPR / UK GDPR rights (EU and UK users): access — obtain a copy of your personal data; rectification — correct inaccurate data; erasure — request deletion (subject to legal hold); restriction — limit processing while a dispute is resolved; portability — receive your data in a machine-readable format; objection — object to processing based on legitimate interests; automated decisions — not to be subject to solely automated decisions with significant effects. To exercise these rights, email support@odaflow.com or use the in-app privacy settings.
legal.privacyRightsDPDPBody: India DPDP Act rights: right to access, correction, and erasure of your digital personal data; right to grievance redressal; right to nominate a person to exercise rights on your behalf. Contact our Consent Manager at support@odaflow.com.
legal.privacyRightsCCPABody: California (CCPA/CPRA) rights: right to know what personal information we collect; right to delete; right to opt out of sale (we do not sell data); right to non-discrimination for exercising rights; right to correct inaccurate information; right to limit use of sensitive personal information.
legal.privacyRightsKenyaBody: Kenya Data Protection Act rights: right to be informed; right of access; right to rectification; right to erasure and blocking; right to object; right to data portability. Contact our local representative at support@odaflow.com.
legal.privacyTransfersBody: Your data may be processed outside your country of residence. For transfers from the UK/EU, we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission and UK ICO. For India, transfers comply with DPDP Act provisions on cross-border data flows. For Kenya, transfers comply with Section 48 of the Kenya Data Protection Act 2019. Enterprise tenants may request data residency restrictions via governance settings.
legal.privacyAutomatedBody: Umbrella uses AI to generate legal analysis, identify issues, and suggest actions. These AI outputs are informational only and do not constitute binding decisions about your legal rights. No fully automated decision with legal or similarly significant effect is made about you without human review. Our AI risk-scoring for fraud detection may affect platform access; you may request human review of any such decision.
legal.privacyCookiesBody: Strictly necessary cookies (session management, security tokens) are always active. Functional cookies (language preference, theme) are set on first use and can be cleared in browser settings. Analytics cookies (Vercel, Sentry) are set only with your consent via the cookie banner. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
legal.privacyChangesBody: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be notified by email and in-app notification at least 30 days before they take effect. Continued use of the platform after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
legal.privacyContactBody: Data protection enquiries: support@odaflow.com. We aim to respond within 10 business days. If you are unsatisfied with our response you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority: UK — ICO (ico.org.uk); EU — your national DPA; India — Data Protection Board of India; Kenya — Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (odpc.go.ke).

legal.dataConsentDescription: This policy explains how DVTech Ventures handles your data in relation to AI model training, evaluation, and improvement. It forms part of our overall Privacy Policy.
legal.dataConsentDefaultHeading: 1. Default: no training on your data
legal.dataConsentDefaultBody: By default, Umbrella does not use your documents, case descriptions, matter notes, client communications, AI queries, or any other user-submitted content to train, fine-tune, or evaluate AI models. This default applies to all users — consumers, Lawyer Users, and firm tenants — regardless of subscription tier. Firm training consent defaults to off for all tenants and can only be enabled by a tenant administrator.
legal.dataConsentWhatIsTrainingBody: AI training in this context means using your data — after anonymization and pseudonymization — to improve the accuracy, relevance, or safety of AI models that power Umbrella features. It does not mean sharing identifiable client data with any third party. Training pipelines are operated by DVTech Ventures or its contracted AI providers under data-processing agreements.
legal.dataConsentOptInIntro: If you choose to opt in, you may enable one or more of the following, each independently:
legal.dataConsentOptInPrompt: Prompt improvement: anonymized patterns from your AI queries are used to improve prompt engineering and reduce hallucinations. No personally identifiable information or case-specific facts are included.
legal.dataConsentOptInEval: Model evaluation: redacted samples from your AI interactions are used to test model quality, safety, and accuracy against benchmarks. Samples are reviewed only by authorised DVTech engineers and contracted AI evaluators under NDA.
legal.dataConsentOptInFineTune: Fine-tuning: with admin approval, pseudonymized legal drafts or matter summaries may be included in fine-tuning datasets to improve domain-specific model performance. Fine-tuning datasets require dual-approval by a tenant admin and a DVTech data governance officer.
legal.dataConsentOptInAnonymize: All opt-in data undergoes anonymization (removal of personal identifiers) and pseudonymization (replacement of names, entities, and case references with synthetic tokens) before entering any training pipeline. Anonymization is verified by automated scanning and, for fine-tuning, manual spot-checks.
legal.dataConsentNeverUsedHeading: 4. Data that is never used for training
legal.dataConsentNeverUsedBody: The following data is never used for AI training under any circumstances, including with opt-in: (a) billing information and payment card data; (b) full client names, national ID numbers, passport numbers, or biometric data without complete anonymization; (c) communications protected by legal professional privilege unless the privilege holder provides explicit written consent; (d) data subject to a legal hold or active litigation; (e) health or medical data; (f) data of users under 18 years of age.
legal.dataConsentProvidersBody: Umbrella routes AI queries to third-party AI providers. For analysis and drafting: OpenAI (GPT models) and DeepSeek. For embeddings and document search: OpenAI. For meeting and voice transcription: Deepgram. These providers process your queries under: (a) zero-data-retention API agreements where available (queries are not used to train provider models); (b) data processing agreements that restrict use to service delivery; (c) appropriate cross-border transfer mechanisms (SCCs for EU/UK; equivalent agreements for other jurisdictions). The specific providers in use for each feature are documented in our subprocessor register available on request.
legal.dataConsentCountryGDPRBody: EU / UK (GDPR / UK GDPR): automated processing that produces legal or similarly significant effects requires a valid legal basis under Art. 22 GDPR. Umbrella does not make binding automated decisions about users. Where AI analysis influences significant outcomes, users are notified and human review is available.
legal.dataConsentCountryDPDPBody: India (DPDP Act 2023): processing of digital personal data for AI training requires explicit consent from the Data Principal. Consent records are maintained and can be reviewed or withdrawn via your account settings.
legal.dataConsentCountryKenyaBody: Kenya (Data Protection Act 2019): automated processing and profiling must be disclosed; data subjects have the right to object. Consent for any AI training use is obtained separately and documented.
legal.dataConsentCountryUSBody: United States: CCPA/CPRA users have the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information. Umbrella does not sell personal information. Sharing data with AI providers for service delivery is not a 'sale' under CCPA. Sensitive personal information is not shared with AI providers without explicit consent.
legal.dataConsentOptInIntroSection: If you opt in, you may separately enable:
legal.dataConsentFirmLink: Firm training consent (tenant admin — Lawyer OS settings)
legal.dataConsentConsumerLink: Consumer data consent settings (your account settings)
legal.dataConsentManageBody: Consent can be granted or withdrawn at any time via your account settings. Changes take effect immediately for future data processing. Withdrawal does not affect processing carried out before the withdrawal.
legal.dataConsentWithdrawBody: You may withdraw your consent at any time via account settings or by emailing support@odaflow.com. Upon withdrawal: (a) no further data from your account will enter any training pipeline; (b) previously anonymized data that has already been incorporated into a trained model cannot be removed from that model (as is technically infeasible with anonymized aggregate data, consistent with GDPR Recital 26); (c) any pending training batches containing your data will be purged within 30 days; (d) you will receive confirmation of withdrawal by email within 5 business days.
legal.dataConsentAuditBody: DVTech Ventures maintains an audit trail of all consent events (grant, modification, withdrawal), data flows into training pipelines, anonymization certifications, and third-party processor instructions. Tenant administrators can request a consent audit report via the governance settings dashboard. We conduct annual AI ethics and data governance reviews.
legal.dataConsentRetentionBody: Anonymized training datasets are retained for the period necessary for model development, typically 24 months from creation. Fine-tuning datasets require explicit re-consent after 12 months. Upon tenant account closure, all training data derived from that tenant's content is purged within 60 days.
legal.dataConsentContactBody: For questions about AI data processing, consent, or to request a copy of consent records: support@odaflow.com. We aim to respond within 10 business days.
legal.deleteAccountDescription: Request deletion of your Umbrella Legal AI account and associated personal data on umbrella.okaylegal.ai and the Umbrella mobile app.
legal.deleteAccountStep1: Sign in to Umbrella at umbrella.okaylegal.ai or open the Umbrella Legal AI mobile app with the account you want to delete.
legal.deleteAccountStep2: Use the deletion form on this page while signed in, or email support@odaflow.com from your registered email address with the subject line "Account deletion request".
legal.deleteAccountStep3: Confirm your account email address. We verify that it matches your signed-in account before processing the request.
legal.deleteAccountStep4: After confirmation, your account is deactivated immediately. Personal data is deleted or anonymized within 30 days, subject to legal retention requirements described below.
legal.deleteAccountDeletedBody: When your account is deleted, we remove or anonymize: your name, email address, phone number, password, consumer profile, issue-checker cases, uploaded documents, legal reports, AI outputs and usage logs tied to your account, lawyer profile (solo users), marketplace leads, training consent records, and active session tokens.
legal.deleteAccountRetainedBody: Some information may be retained where required by law or for legitimate business needs: billing and tax records (up to 7 years), security and audit logs (up to 12 months), anonymized analytics that cannot identify you, and law firm workspace data if you were a member of a firm tenant (managed by your firm administrator).
legal.deleteAccountRetentionBody: Most personal data is deleted or anonymized within 30 days of a confirmed deletion request. Backup copies containing your data are purged on a rolling basis within 90 days.
legal.deleteAccountPartialHeading: Delete some data without deleting your account
legal.deleteAccountPartialBody: Yes. You can delete individual issue-checker cases, uploaded documents, and AI conversation history from within the app or web dashboard without closing your entire account. Email support@odaflow.com if you need help removing specific data.
legal.deleteAccountFirmBody: If you belong to a law firm workspace, deleting your personal user account removes your profile and access but may not delete matter or client data held by the firm. Firm administrators should contact support@odaflow.com for tenant-level deletion.
legal.deleteAccountContactBody: Email support@odaflow.com from your registered address. We aim to respond within 10 business days.
